svg.text: Seven outer layers: about 4 × 1018 people, roughly the grains of sand on Earth.

text.font-family: Iowan Old Style, Charter, Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: Add the inner life (× 518,400): about 2 × 1024, roughly the stars in the observable universe.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The name comes from the core three alone: Bazi × World × Body ≈ 1.07 trillion valid. Counts are combinations, not proven-different people.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bazi is used as a grammar for fiction, not fortune-telling. Dashed lines: outer layers are drawn independently, never derived from the chart.
